Class Quad3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Quad3D
public class Quad3D extends Item3D
A single filled (and optionally framed) quadrilateral, defined by four corner vertices in world coordinates. Corners are expected in either winding order around the quad's perimeter, not crossed.

    • setLighted

      public void setLighted(boolean lighted)
      Enable or disable Phong-style lighting for this quad.

      When enabled, the quad is drawn with a single face normal (computed via Support3D.drawShadedQuad(GLAutoDrawable, float[], Color, Color, float, boolean)) so its shading visibly changes as it — or the scene around it — rotates. Works for a quad at any orientation, not just axis-aligned ones. Disabled by default, matching the flat-colour appearance existing callers already expect.

      Parameters:
      lighted - true to enable lighting; false for flat colour
